vibe: High-end luxury fashion, editorial, minimalistic, premium. The interface gets out of the way of the clothes and the user's photos, allowing the fashion to be the true hero.

layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat, no shadow, 1px #E5E5E5 border, 0px border-radius. Minimalist editorial look. Images inside cards should have 0px border-radius.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (borderRadius: 0), solid #0A0A0A background for primary, pure white background with 1px border for secondary. Minimum height: 56px for touch targets.
components.inputs: Underline only (borderBottomWidth: 1) or full flat rectangle with 1px border and 0px radius. Generous padding (16px).
components.bottom_tabs: Minimalist @expo/vector-icons (Feather or Ionicons), active state is solid black icon, inactive is light grey (#A3A3A3). No text labels, height 80px with safe area inset.
components.image_containers: Aspect ratio 3:4 or 4:5 (editorial portrait). 0px border radius. Overlay text must have high contrast, use dark gradients if overlaying white text.
components.bottom_sheet: For Size Guide, Filters, and Try-On parameters. Use borderTopLeftRadius 24px and borderTopRightRadius 24px to soften interactions.

icons_library: @expo/vector-icons (Feather preferred for thin, elegant strokes that match the Swiss/Editorial vibe)

hero_models.description: Editorial model in long coat, perfect for the main discovery feed or virtual try-on placeholder.
Artistic moody portrait, ideal for the onboarding background before body profile setup.

products.description: White crew neck flat lay, use as sample clothing product item in the feed.

technical_rules: Use StyleSheet for all styling. DO NOT USE Tailwind, pure CSS, or web frameworks.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `testID` (for React Native) or `data-testid` attribute for testing.
Do NOT use Shadcn UI. Build native UI using React Native primitives (View, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, FlatList, ScrollView).
Images must use responsive sizing with flex: 1 and appropriate resizeMode ('cover' for editorial shots, 'contain' for flatlays).
instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Expo app following the Swiss Brutalist/Editorial archetype: stark contrast, sharp corners, and massive typography. Let the photos dominate.

Implement the exact user flows: Onboarding (Body dimensions & photos), AI Try-On Screen (image compositing simulation), Discovery Feed (FlatList of clothes), Product Detail (Size guide, Try On, Buy Now), Seller Dashboard, and Buyer Profile.
Use react-native-safe-area-context to handle notches seamlessly.
Load custom fonts (Cormorant Garamond, Manrope) via expo-font during the app loading phase.
Ensure the AI try-on composite screen handles two images (user body + product) beautifully, perhaps with an absolute positioned overlay simulation.
